sloka: इत्येवं रममाणानां देवानामिव नन्दने ।भरद्वाजाश्रमे रम्ये सा रात्रिर्व्यत्यवर्त्तत ॥ २.९१.८१॥
transliteration: ityevaṁ ramamāṇānāṁ devānāmiva nandane ।bharadvājāśrame ramye sā rātrirvyatyavarttata ॥ 2.91.81॥

translations.english: The men were amazed when they beheld the wonderful hospitality extended by maharshi Bharadwaja to Bharata, as if all this happened in a dream world.
